paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s Jingle Bell Hop runs from 4 to 7 p.m. Thursday, Dec. 3. It opens a run of three Thursday evenings on the Pontotoc County Chamber calendar. Each ends at 7 p.m., but the downtown Christmas party in the middle starts an hour later than the other two.

The Merry Little Christmas Party takes place downtown Thursday, Dec. 10, from 5 to 7 p.m. The Chamber lists it three days after Pontotoc’s annual Christmas parade, which is scheduled for Monday, Dec. 7.

Mistletoe Madness brings back the 4 p.m. start on Thursday, Dec. 17. Its flyer advertises free gift wrapping with a purchase that evening. For questions about which shops are taking part, the Chamber lists 662-489-5042.
